entries.subject: DAMIT 1845: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-1845.txt. Model 1845, version 2017-09-21, pole (298°, 59°), period 11.8901 h match the retained metadata. The archive diameter field is 210 ±23 km; its applicability to our scale is a separate calibration decision. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: Registered surface imagery
entries.finding: Shape uses the shared missing-imagery grid. DAMIT's viewer illustrations are not source surface maps; no albedo, photographic color, regolith or composition is inferred.
entries.revisitWhen: A released, reusable surface observation or mapped product with registration to this body’s selected source model; the existing grid alone does not imply that every archive was searched.

entries.subject: Other DAMIT shape solutions
entries.finding: The live DAMIT export lists these other models for this target: 936: pole (297°, 61°), 11.8901 h, version 2016-01-04. These are archive alternatives, not necessarily newly released models or preferred replacements. Comparing their source methods and any pole-specific calibration remains necessary before changing the selected mesh.
entries.revisitWhen: Independent shape, spin or scale evidence distinguishes these alternatives, or a changed release offers a demonstrably better supported model.

entries.subject: VLT/SPHERE/ZIMPOL deconvolved frames as a computed-camera photograph lens
entries.finding: The survey holds 10 deconvolved ZIMPOL frames (camera 1) for this body; the cross-frame registration test could not be run on them in this pass.
entries.revisitWhen: Frames and a pinned Horizons table for this body, to run the cross-frame registration test.
